content: Implement end-to-end tests and full integration verification for user search
activeForm: Implementing end-to-end tests and full integration verification for user search
description: Create comprehensive end-to-end test suite for complete user search functionality covering real-world scenarios and user flows. Tests verify full stack integration from HTTP request through database and back, including data setup, search execution, result verification, and cleanup. Write 7 E2E tests covering: search for pickleball players and get results, search with multiple filters and pagination, create user then search and verify in results, soft delete user then verify exclusion from search, complex multi-filter search scenarios, concurrent search during user creation, and search cache invalidation. Each test uses real database with setup/teardown, makes actual HTTP requests to the search endpoint, and verifies response format, status codes, pagination metadata, and result accuracy. This subtask provides confidence that the entire search feature works correctly in production-like conditions.

phases.name: E2E Test Suite (7 tests)
actions: Test 1: Search for pickleball players
- Create 3 users: 2 with pickleball, 1 with paddle
- GET /api/users/search?sport=pickleball
- Verify: 200 status, 2 results, correct user data
Test 2: Search with filters and pagination
- Create 25 users with various sports and locations
- GET /api/users/search?location_city=SF&limit=10&offset=0
- Verify: 10 results, pagination metadata, hasMore=true
- GET /api/users/search?location_city=SF&limit=10&offset=10
- Verify: Next page results, consistent ordering
Test 3: Create user then search and find in results
- Create user with username='testplayer' and sport='pickleball'
- GET /api/users/search?query=testplayer
- Verify: User appears in results immediately
Test 4: Soft delete user then verify exclusion
- Create active user with pickleball
- GET /api/users/search?sport=pickleball → user present
- Soft delete user (is_active=false)
- GET /api/users/search?sport=pickleball → user absent
Test 5: Complex multi-filter search
- Create users with various combinations of sport, skill_level, location
- GET /api/users/search?sport=pickleball&skill_level=advanced&location_city=NYC
- Verify: Only users matching ALL filters returned
Test 6: Search during user creation (concurrency)
- Start search request
- Concurrently create user
- Verify: No errors, consistent results
Test 7: Search result ordering by relevance
- Create users with usernames: 'pickleball', 'pickleballfan', 'paddle_pickleball'
- GET /api/users/search?query=pickleball
- Verify: Exact match 'pickleball' ranks first, others follow
